added: A new Settings › Defaults section lets you choose which dance details (author, formation, level, mixer, status, phrase, calling notes, walkthrough, and suggested tunes) appear when you share, copy, or print/export a program or dance. Authors are shown by default; suggested tunes are off by default since no export showed them before.
Sharing or copying a program's plain set list now shows each dance's author right on the numbered line, even for a dance with no figures entered.

Add the DanceShareField picker's rendering semantics to danceToPlainText and programToPlainText: an optional fields parameter gates each non-figures field, and an optional authorNamesFor resolver adds an author suffix to the set-list slot line.
